verdict.rationale: EFTPS is an online federal tax payment service, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for such a service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI assistant. The only help channels are human Customer Service Agents and a prompt-driven phone voice response system for making payments, and neither is an AI assistant you can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
